title: Coolant leak at laser weld seam - charge air cooler tank
failure_mode: Coolant leakage at laser weld seam
process_step: OP20 laser welding tank to core plate
symptom: Leak at customer EOL test, lack of penetration at seam start
root_cause_family: Laser power loss due to protective glass contamination
occurrence_cause: Spatter on protective glass reduced power at workpiece; glass changed on fixed interval only
escape_cause: In-house leak test at lower pressure than customer EOL
corrective_actions: Inline laser power monitoring with interlock
Leak test pressure aligned to customer EOL
Protective glass change on power drop
lessons_learned: Monitor power at workpiece, not at source. Align in-house leak test pressure with customer end-of-line test. Read across to all laser-welded coolers.
